wedding-itinerary-pages.summary: A vertical, multi-page Indian wedding invite. A pale sage cover draws a thin hand-drawn gold ring with leaf sprigs around an "A | K" monogram, fades in "Anaya & Kabir" in script and types the dates and a wedding hashtag, over rolling paper-cut hills with a domed chhatri. The pages then turn with soft color crossfades to a butter yellow Haldi page with a marigold garland frame and a low seat with bolsters, a night teal Sangeet page with string lights, stars, diyas and a dhol, a blush Wedding and Reception page with a gold four-pillar mandap under a floral arch, and a warm cream RSVP page back in the garden. Every detail line types on with a thin blinking caret.

beats.what: Garden hills and a chhatri rise in from below while the gold ring draws itself around the A | K monogram
Anaya & Kabir fades up in script, a divider grows, then the dates and #KabirFoundHisAnaya type on with a caret
The page eases to butter yellow; marigold strands and a cushioned seat rise in, Haldi fades up and its date, venue and schedule type on
Night teal Sangeet page: twinkling string lights, stars, diyas and a dhol rise in as the details type
Blush Wedding & Reception page with a gold mandap, floral arch and aisle; date, venue and timings type on
Warm cream closing page back in the garden: We can't wait to celebrate with you, then RSVP by 1 October and Ritu & Vikram Mehra type on

miniature-panorama.summary: A vertical, flat paper-cut Rajasthani lakeside pans sideways in slow parallax behind a wedding invitation: domed chhatri pavilions, cypress and palm trees, a lake with swans and lotus, a marble railing with a peacock, a sandy path and front hedges under swaying marigold strings. The sky eases from pale blue day through an apricot sunset to deep indigo night, diyas and pavilion lamps light up and stars appear, then a small baraat procession with a decorated elephant and lantern bearers walks along the path. Script names "Tara & Vihaan" with "are getting married" and the date sit in the sky and turn from dark ink to cream as night falls.

beats.what: Daytime lakeside pans left in parallax under hanging marigold strings, birds drifting across a pale blue sky
The names, the line and the date fade in and rise one after another in the sky
The sky warms to an apricot and rose sunset and the scenery takes a warm tint
Diyas on the railing and lamps in the pavilions glow on
Night falls to deep indigo, stars come out and the text turns cream; the baraat procession walks in from the left
The elephant with its golden canopy and lantern bearers cross the path as the clip fades out

botanical-save-the-date.summary: A vertical wedding save the date on warm ivory paper inside a fine gold border. Line-drawn eucalyptus and olive sprigs grow in from the corners and sway for the whole clip while the invitation plays in calm beats: a four-line poem alternating spaced serif capitals and terracotta script, a stacked SAVE the DATE with 18 . 04 . 2027 under a short gold rule, "for the wedding of" Ishita and Rohan, three event cards whose gold frames draw themselves (a leaf-cornered rectangle for the Mehendi, a hexagon for the Ring Ceremony, a tall arch for the Wedding) and a closing "Your presence is the greatest gift" signed by The Khanna Family in script.

beats.what: Gold border draws from the top center while eucalyptus and olive sprigs grow in from the corners, leaves opening one by one
Poem rises in line by line: serif capitals alternating with terracotta script
SAVE, script the, DATE stack in, a gold rule grows and the date 18 . 04 . 2027 appears
"For the wedding of" Ishita, script and, Rohan
A gold rectangle with leaf corners draws on around the Mehendi card: title, date and time, venue, address
A gold hexagon draws on for the Ring Ceremony card
A tall gold arch draws on for the Wedding card
Closing: "Your presence is the greatest gift", a gold rule, "with love from" and The Khanna Family in script, then holds
